nodes.label: Physician Register-Assess-Review-Sign Flow
nodes.rationale: Register, assess, review AI proposal, finalize and sign gives physicians a governed path from intake to signed plan with follow-up re-assessment.

nodes.label: One Bayesian Network Per Clinical Question
nodes.rationale: Seven registration and six follow-up questions each get their own network so recommendations stay scoped, sequential and reviewable.

nodes.label: Research-App Login Warning
nodes.rationale: Physicians must see that the prototype is not the sole basis for treatment, since outputs are exploratory rather than validated care guidance.

nodes.label: MCP Run Transparency Requirement
nodes.rationale: Showing question, network version, supplied inputs, returned CPTs and result alongside each recommendation lets physicians audit the pipeline.
